Maria Chen: Quick security follow-up from today's all-hands. Dropping live Qs and owners here.
Sanjay Patel: BYOK question: Private VPC BYOK targeted Q3; hosted BYOK needs HSM/legal changes, target Q4 (pending gating).
Alex Rivera: Audit log retention: default 90d; enterprise tiers to 1/3/7y with export hooks. Export SLA: standard 24h, expedited 4h for pre-approved audits.
Jess Liu: ISO readiness: reuse SOC2 artifacts where possible; supplier/vendor assessments will be additional. I'll produce a gap matrix.
Tyler Nguyen: SLA proposals: p99 <= 350ms for small hosted models; error budget 0.1%/month.
legal-bot: Note: privacy review required for cross-border log exports and any PII redaction rules before customer promises.
Maria Chen: Action items: @Sanjay publish BYOK gating checklist; @Alex draft export schema and pricing; @Jess own ISO gap list; @Tyler draft SLA copy. Loop in Legal/Privacy before public statements. Thanks!
